描述_EN: the term cizhou encapsulates a range of popular wares made in several regions of northern china. ceramic pillows were an important item in the kilns producing cizhou wares, and were made for both funerary use and as a neck support for the living. this pillow would have had special meaning for its owner, as lions were sacred animals to buddhists. this pillow is an example of cizhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the northern part of china during the jin dynasty (1115-1234). the stoneware body of this piece has taken on the shape of a lion through clever use of moulding techniques and its amber glaze.
描述_ZN: 术语 "Cizhou "概括了在中国北部几个地区制造的一系列流行的器物。 陶瓷枕头是窑厂生产的重要物品，既可用于葬礼，也可作为生活中的颈部支撑。 这个枕头对它的主人有特殊的意义，因为狮子是佛教徒的神圣动物。 这个枕头是贵州器的一个例子，贵州器是中国北方地区在金代（1115-1234）时制造的一种陶瓷。 这件作品的石器主体通过巧妙地使用铸模技术和琥珀色的釉面而呈现出狮子的形状。
